teaser: How a person gets their own agentic cell: a key pair in the browser, a vault they fill themselves, the site factory, and then their own Claude.
core_idea: The product is the workflow: a signed, encrypted intake through keys and vaults, the site factory and a hand-over, automated except for three human gates.

nodes.label: A signed request
nodes.summary: On an append lane, no secrets.

nodes.label: Their own vault
nodes.summary: Filled by them, sealed to the factory.

nodes.label: Their own Claude
nodes.summary: A collaborator invite and a CLAUDE.md.

quotes.text: So the thing to build is not the site; it is the workflow.
the worst anyone can do is send a request
No key ever travels in clear.

figures.caption: Your own agentic cell: a key, a request, a vault, the factory, five designs, a hand-over; three human gates.
